# workflows

CI and release workflows.

| Workflow | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`pages.yml`](pages.yml) | Builds the project site: the pages in [`site/`](../../site/README.md) in both languages, the introduction, the language tour and the page of the tools, which links to the files of the desktop viewer's newest tag `viewer-vX.Y.Z`; the pages of the language standard with [`scripts/spec/`](../../scripts/spec/README.md); the RNL skill package, its zip and plain-text files and `llms.txt` with [`scripts/skill/`](../../scripts/skill/build.py), the entry for agents; and the web viewer of [`apps/web`](../../apps/web/README.md) with its samples, at `viewer/`, for which it installs Rust with the WebAssembly target, Node and Python, and writes the web fonts with [`scripts/fonts.py`](../../scripts/README.md). It keeps the Cargo registry and the core's WebAssembly build between runs, and the web fonts until `scripts/fonts.py` changes. On pull requests that touch the site, the standard or what the web viewer is built from, it only checks the build, which fails when text has no English source or has malformed translation groups, a check of the standard fails or the web viewer does not build; on `main` it also publishes the site to GitHub Pages. It runs on `main` again after `spec-release.yml` succeeds, so that the pages of the standard carry the new revision label, and after `viewer-release.yml` ("Viewer release") succeeds, so that the page of the tools links to the new release; only `main` may deploy to the `github-pages` environment, and only the deploy job may write to Pages. Pages must use "GitHub Actions" as its source. |
| [`skill.yml`](skill.yml) | Checks the RNL skill package in [`skills/`](../../skills/README.md): builds the `rnl` command, requires that the files generated from the package files are what they give, that the package is whole, and that every netlist in it reads with `rnl check` without errors or warnings ([`scripts/skill`](../../scripts/skill/build.py)). Runs on pushes to `main` and on pull requests that touch the package, its script, the short guide, the pages for agents, the standard library or the crates. |
| [`spec-release.yml`](spec-release.yml) | On a tag such as `spec-0.2-r1`, builds every form of that version of the standard and attaches them to the GitHub release "RNL 0.2, revision 1"; the tag's message becomes the release notes ([decision 0007](../../docs/decisions/0007-publishing-the-standard.md)). |
| [`desktop.yml`](desktop.yml) | Checks formatting, runs clippy and the tests of the desktop viewer in [`apps/desktop`](../../apps/desktop/README.md) on Linux, Windows and macOS, with the web fonts of the page it embeds written by [`scripts/fonts.py`](../../scripts/README.md), and checks every script of the page, [`apps/viewer-ui`](../../apps/viewer-ui/README.md), and of the app's tests. On Windows it also runs the app's smoke test through WebView2's DevTools port; on Linux it builds the app and opens a sample under Xvfb through WebKitGTK WebDriver. Runs on pushes to `main` and on pull requests that touch the viewer, its page, the crates, the standard library, the font script or the netlist the smoke test opens. |
| [`viewer-release.yml`](viewer-release.yml) | Builds the desktop viewer for Windows x64 (portable executable, NSIS and MSI) and Linux x86_64 (AppImage and deb), with the pinned Tauri CLI and web fonts. Windows keeps the MSVC loader check and standalone/installer smoke tests. Linux builds on Ubuntu 22.04 and tests the AppImage and installed deb under Xvfb, then uninstalls the deb and checks cleanup. After both jobs pass, verifies the platform checksums and writes one combined `SHA256SUMS.txt`. A pushed `viewer-v<version>` tag must match the app's version and have release notes; it publishes the five binaries and checksums as `RNL Viewer <version>`, with `--latest=false` so the core owns latest. Manual runs build and test both platforms and keep their artifacts and screenshots without publishing ([Releasing](../../apps/desktop/README.md#releasing)). |
| [`core-release.yml`](core-release.yml) | Builds the four native CLI archives and npm tarball, checks tag/workspace version and notes before building, tests extracted CLIs, verifies static linkage and byte parity with the debug CLI. Runs for relevant PRs, by reusable call and manually. Manual `candidate_tag` validates without pushing any tag; manual runs never publish. Keeps platform artifacts and combined archives with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. |
| [`publish-runtime.yml`](publish-runtime.yml) | On `core-v*`, calls Core release, waits for every build/test, publishes the tested npm tarball through the existing OIDC identity, smoke-tests the published version, then publishes RNL core as GitHub latest. Requires the user-decided `CORE_NPM_DIST_TAG` (`next` or `latest`). Manual dispatch builds only; `runtime-v*` is retired. [Failure/recovery and version decisions](../../docs/releases.md). |
| [`viewer.yml`](viewer.yml) | Tests the viewers' shared page in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with Playwright, against a fake shell, and smoke-tests the web viewer's site with the core as WebAssembly ([`tests/viewer`](../../tests/viewer/README.md)), on Linux; installs Rust with the WebAssembly target and the browsers with what they need, and keeps the report of a failed run. Runs on pushes to `main` and on pull requests that touch the page, the web viewer, the bindings, the tests, the conformance corpus, the crates or the standard library. |
| [`rust.yml`](rust.yml) | Checks formatting, runs clippy and the tests of the Rust workspace on Linux, Windows and macOS. On Linux it also builds the core crates and the WebAssembly binding in [`bindings/runtime-wasm`](../../bindings/runtime-wasm/README.md), tests the binding's JavaScript modules, and requires that native and WebAssembly builds give identical Documents on the conformance corpus and the standard packages; and it downloads the pinned fonts and requires that the renderer's font metrics are what they give (`python scripts/fonts.py metrics --check`). Runs on pushes to `main` and on pull requests that touch the crates, the bindings, the standard library, the test corpora or the font script; changes to the page's tests in `tests/viewer` alone are left to `viewer.yml`. |
| [`web.yml`](web.yml) | Builds the web viewer in [`apps/web`](../../apps/web/README.md) on Linux: the web fonts with [`scripts/fonts.py`](../../scripts/README.md), the core as WebAssembly and the site with the samples; checks every script of the site with `node --check`, and that the site is served with the MIME types a browser needs. Runs on pushes to `main` and on pull requests that touch the web viewer, the page, the bindings, the crates, the standard library, the font script or the conformance corpus, which gives the samples. |

`pages.yml` and `spec-release.yml` install pandoc, Typst and the CJK fonts at pinned versions through the local action [`install-spec-tools`](../actions/install-spec-tools/action.yml), which checks the SHA-256 of each download against the one its GitHub release gives.

Pages also rebuilds after **Publish runtime** succeeds, including the independent core
pipeline when it lands. Its homepage timeline reads release tags and localized summaries with English fallback
from the release notes, with editorial overrides in `site/src/timeline.json`; see the
[release summary checklist](../../release-notes/README.md). This adds a site rebuild trigger
without changing any release workflow's publishing behavior.

Every action is pinned to the commit of its release, with the release in a comment after it, such as `actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1`, so that a tag moved later cannot change what runs. To update one, pin the commit its new release's tag names. `publish-runtime.yml` installs npm by an exact version too.

See the [roadmap](../../docs/roadmap.md) for planned work.

Core, Viewer and language use independent versions ([decision 0013](../../docs/decisions/0013-independent-release-lines.md)). Core owns latest; both other release workflows explicitly use `--latest=false`. Existing releases are untouched.
